about_the_game:
Summer Forest Tileset is a collection of pixelart tileset material to create a vibrant and detailed forest for your game.

 

Whether more modern or set in a fantasy world, this set of large, detailed trees and other forest assets can help you make a lush environment. Suited for both normal and parallax mapping.

 

Includes:

●     Light and dark grass tiles

●     Dirt and stone paths, as well and underbrush tiles

●     Fence tiles

●     Animated water tiles for all ground types

●     Animated waterfall

●     Cliff tiles

●     3 large trees, and 2 dead trees

●     An assortment of bushes, flowers, grasses and plants

●     Signs, statues, rocks and other objects

●     Animated butterflies

 

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

 

 

【Tilesets (4 sheets)】

 

●     A1 tiles：1 sheet

●     A2 tiles：1 sheet

●     A4 tiles：1 sheet

●     B tiles：1 sheet

 

 

【Character (3 sheets)】

 

●     Butterflies

●     Water shimmer

●     Rocks in the water

  

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
